package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequestSchema = "teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff-request.v1"
	TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffSchema        = "teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1"
	OnboardingPlanHandoffAccepted             = "ACCEPTED"
	OnboardingPlanExecutionNotStarted         = "NOT_STARTED"
	OnboardingPlanContentNotCreated           = "NOT_CREATED"
)

// TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest contains only Teacher audit identities
// and the Student state revision that was observed in the dialog. It never
// carries Student profile facts or free text.
type TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest struct {
	Schema           string                   `json:"schema"`
	ExpectedStateRef StudentReadinessStateRef `json:"expected_state_ref"`
	DialogID         string                   `json:"dialog_id"`
	TeacherJobID     string                   `json:"teacher_job_id"`
}

type TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff struct {
	Schema              string                   `json:"schema"`
	HandoffID           string                   `json:"handoff_id"`
	Status              string                   `json:"status"`
	StateRef            StudentReadinessStateRef `json:"state_ref"`
	Goal                LearningReadinessGoal    `json:"goal"`
	ExecutionStatus     string                   `json:"execution_status"`
	ContentStatus       string                   `json:"content_status"`
	ReadinessObservedAt time.Time                `json:"readiness_observed_at"`
	Replayed            bool                     `json:"replayed"`
}

// OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord is the immutable, Planner-owned receipt. It
// deliberately stores bounded audit identifiers only, never profile data or
// dialog content.
type OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord struct {
	HandoffID           string
	StudentID           string
	IdempotencyKey      string
	RequestHash         string
	StateRef            StudentReadinessStateRef
	DialogID            string
	TeacherJobID        string
	Goal                LearningReadinessGoal
	ReadinessObservedAt time.Time
	CreatedAt           time.Time
}

func NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest(input TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest) (TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest, error) {
	if input.Schema != TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequestSchema ||
		!validAcceptedReadinessStateRef(input.ExpectedStateRef) ||
		!canonicalReadinessUUID(input.DialogID) || !canonicalReadinessUUID(input.TeacherJobID) {
		return TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}

func NormalizeOnboardingPlanHandoffRecord(input OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord) (OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, error) {
	if !canonicalReadinessUUID(input.HandoffID) || !canonicalReadinessUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!canonicalReadinessUUID(input.IdempotencyKey) || len(input.RequestHash) != 64 ||
		!validAcceptedReadinessStateRef(input.StateRef) || !canonicalReadinessUUID(input.DialogID) ||
		!canonicalReadinessUUID(input.TeacherJobID) || !validReadinessGoal(input.Goal) || input.ReadinessObservedAt.IsZero() ||
		input.CreatedAt.IsZero() || input.CreatedAt.Before(input.ReadinessObservedAt) {
		return OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{}, ErrValidation
	}
	for _, current := range input.RequestHash {
		if !(current >= '0' && current <= '9' || current >= 'a' && current <= 'f') {
			return OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{}, ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return input, nil
}

func NewTeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequestHash(studentID string, input TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest) (string, error) {
	if !canonicalReadinessUUID(studentID) {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	normalized, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest(input)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		StudentID string                              `json:"student_id"`
		Request   TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest `json:"request"`
	}{StudentID: studentID, Request: normalized})
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(payload)
	return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), nil
}

func OnboardingPlanHandoffResponse(record OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, replayed bool) (TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff, error) {
	record, err := NormalizeOnboardingPlanHandoffRecord(record)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, err
	}
	return TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{
		Schema: TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffSchema, HandoffID: record.HandoffID,
		Status: OnboardingPlanHandoffAccepted, StateRef: record.StateRef, Goal: record.Goal,
		ExecutionStatus: OnboardingPlanExecutionNotStarted, ContentStatus: OnboardingPlanContentNotCreated,
		ReadinessObservedAt: record.ReadinessObservedAt.UTC(),
		Replayed:            replayed,
	}, nil
}

func validAcceptedReadinessStateRef(input StudentReadinessStateRef) bool {
	return (input.Kind == StudentReadinessStateDraft || input.Kind == StudentReadinessStateFinalized) && input.Version >= 1
}

func validReadinessGoal(input LearningReadinessGoal) bool {
	return validExactReadinessCode(input.Code) && validExactReadinessCode(input.Version) &&
		strings.TrimSpace(input.GraphVersion) == input.GraphVersion && len(input.GraphVersion) > 0 && len(input.GraphVersion) <= 128
}
